scenario_description:
Objective: Add a small fresh-herb garnish option to Laurel's confirmed soup-and-story supper if a neighborhood source becomes useful in time.
Emerging Need: A limited free clipping-bundle offer appears before there is a definite supper; later planning fixes the date, table style, and Rhea's compatible contribution.
Decision Context: Stored host preferences and consent determine whether a no-cost cancellable hold is welcome, while event records show the offer's deadline and allocation status.
Consequence: Timely handling can make the table a little more seasonal without affecting the meal plan; after holds close, the supper simply proceeds without the extra garnish.

parameter.subject: Free herb clipping bundles for neighborhood meals
parameter.body: For meals happening Oct. 31-Nov. 1, the Ladd Seed Library has eight mixed culinary herb clipping bundles available at no cost. Holds are cancellable until pickup. To reserve one, email garden-desk@laddseedlibrary.org before Thursday, Oct. 29 at 12:00 p.m. with pickup day only; attendee names are not needed. Pickup is Saturday, Oct. 31, 10:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m.

parameter.content: I might host a very low-key soup-and-story on Sunday Nov. 1 if the week stays manageable. Please don't plan around it yet; I'll confirm once I know whether the table reset is realistic.

parameter.title: Laurel soup-and-story supper
parameter.description: Confirmed small soup-and-story supper at Laurel's; family-style table, no assigned dishes listed yet.
Squash, red lentils, onions, and broth for Rhea's Nov. 1 soup-and-story contribution; no fresh garnish herbs purchased.

parameter.subject: October 31 herb-bundle pickup holds are full
parameter.body: All mixed culinary herb clipping bundles for Saturday October 31 pickup, 10:00–12:00, have been allocated to advance holds. Those bundles were offered for meals on October 31 or November 1. There will be no walk-up bundles this weekend; later November notices are separate.
